verifier_a.independent_derivation_or_calculation: Independent step-by-step verification: Step 1: Definition of linear momentum p = m v. Dimensional check: [p] = [M L T^-1]. Step 2: Vector definition of angular momentum L_O = r x p = m (r x v). Cross product properties: magnitude |L_O| = r p sin(theta), direction perpendicular to plane of r and p via right-hand rule. Dimensions: [L_O] = [M L^2 T^-1]. Step 3: Product rule differentiation: dL_O/dt = (dr/dt x p) + (r x dp/dt). Step 4: dr/dt x p = v x (m v) = m (v x v) = 0 since any vector crossed with itself is the zero vector. Step 5: dp/dt = F_net by Newton's second law in an inertial frame. Thus dL_O/dt = r x F_net = tau_O. Step 6: Lever arm formulation: |L_O| = m v (r sin theta) = m v r_perp = p r_perp. Limiting cases: when r_perp = 0 (velocity vector passes through origin), L_O = 0; when v = 0, L_O = 0. All 6 steps mathematically sound and dimensionally balanced.
findings: Step-by-step differentiation of cross product dL/dt = v x p + r x dp/dt verified.
